notes.title: Bear Haven 2 is here!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Bear Haven 2! This time we built our motel deep in the woods.
Nothing will disturb your peace of mind away from civilization.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571450/Bear_Haven_Nights_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571450/Bear_Haven_Nights_2/[/url]

Now, you are the Test Subject 37.  
We have launched a new testing cycle of our new security system.
At night we have some strange problems with alarm, but we're sure you'll manage to fix this.
Please don't forget, if anything is broken by 6:00 am you will loose!

notes.title: Bear Haven Nights Update (964765)
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the feedback!

I've included important fixes in this update:

- Right click to hide the cell phone
- Gameplay overall tweaks
- It's easier to hide from bears now
- TV, Phone, etc. timers are now less active
- Translations fixes
- Fixed a crash on specific configurations
- Small bug fixes and performance improvements

I hope now the game should became a bit more fun and interesting and not that hardcore. :)
